children: Q3 2026 revenue was RMB2.6B, down 26.6% year over year, and net profit was RMB205.6M, down from RMB640.7M. FinVolution reiterated 2026 revenue guidance of RMB11.5B–RMB12.9B.
Q3 net profit RMB205.6M vs RMB640.7M
Profit fell sharply year over year, reflecting weaker earnings amid China market headwinds.
Revenue contracted 26.6% year over year as China loan facilitation and related income declined.
FY2026 revenue guidance unchanged at RMB11.5B–RMB12.9B
Guidance was maintained despite expected fourth-quarter pressure from tighter funding and a challenging China credit environment.
Overseas growth partly offsets mainland weakness; the segment contributed 37.1% of quarterly revenue.
The October debt repurchase reduced outstanding convertible principal; the release gives no repurchase price.

This is a quarterly results update showing material earnings pressure in China alongside continued overseas growth. A larger catalyst would require subsequent quarters to show stabilization in mainland funding and credit conditions, or results that shift the reiterated revenue outlook.
